src: APPSC Assistant Statistical Officer & Other Posts General St
s:
Which of the following is/are components of the PM Electric Drive Revolution in Innovative Vehicle Enhancement (PM E-DRIVE) Scheme 2024 as of January 2025?

A. Demand incentives for e-2W, e-3W, e-ambulances, e-trucks, and emerging EV categories.

B. Grants for the establishment of an electric vehicle manufacturing plant in the private sector.

C. Creation of a network of charging stations and upgradation of testing agencies.

D. Creation of tax rebates for individuals purchasing electric vehicles.
x: PM E-DRIVE (Ministry of Heavy Industries, ₹10,900 crore, from 1 Oct 2024) has two components: demand incentives for e-2W, e-3W, e-ambulances, e-trucks and other emerging EVs (A), and grants for capital assets – e-buses, the charging network and upgradation of testing agencies (C). It gives no grants for private EV manufacturing plants (B – that is the PLI route) and no tax rebates for buyers (D), so 'A and C only'.
